subtitle: 描述你每天上學或上班的路上，以及你怎麼利用這段時間
task: Describe how you get to school or work every day. How long does the trip take, what do you do on the way, and how do you feel about it?
taskZh: 描述你每天怎麼上學或上班：路程要多久、路上做些什麼，以及你對這段通勤的感受。
focus: 清楚交代路程、時間與路上做的事
用現在簡單式描述習慣
用 although、instead of 等表達對比

en: Every school day, I take the MRT to school, and the trip takes about forty minutes. I leave home at seven o'clock, walk to the station, and squeeze into a crowded train. Although the ride is long, I have learned to use the time well.

Most mornings, I listen to English podcasts while I stand by the door. If I get a seat, I review my vocabulary cards or finish my reading for class. Sometimes I simply look out the window and watch the city wake up. Instead of feeling bored, I feel calm and ready for the day.

Of course, my commute is not always pleasant. When it rains, the station becomes wet and slippery, and everyone seems to be in a hurry. Even so, I would rather take the MRT than ride a scooter, because it is safer and better for the environment. For me, these forty minutes are a small but useful part of my day.
zh: 每個上學日，我都搭捷運上學，路程大約四十分鐘。我七點出門，走到車站，擠進一班擁擠的列車。雖然車程很長，但我已經學會好好利用這段時間。
大部分的早上，我會站在車門旁聽英文 Podcast。如果有位子坐，我就複習單字卡，或把上課要讀的文章讀完。有時候我只是看著窗外，看城市慢慢甦醒。我不覺得無聊，反而覺得平靜，準備好迎接新的一天。
當然，通勤不總是愉快的。下雨時，車站又濕又滑，每個人似乎都很趕。即使如此，我還是寧願搭捷運也不要騎機車，因為它比較安全，也對環境比較好。對我來說，這四十分鐘是一天中小小卻有用的一部分。
